summary: This work improves WebRender, Firefox’s GPU-powered page renderer, with refinements to how it draws text, borders, gradients, shadows, clips and filtered content—helping pages look sharper and reducing visual glitches. It also avoids some unnecessary graphics uploads and redraws, and continues a major shift toward clearer, more flexible GPU backends. Developers gained tools to inspect and edit shaders while Firefox is running, while compositor and video changes improve compatibility across graphics hardware and platforms.
